name: br-eli-mcp
description: Brazilian federal law with verifiable citations: bills (Camara dos Deputados), legislation by URN Lex with real article text (Senado, normas.leg.br), and case law from STJ, TST, TCU and CARF plus DataJud CNJ docket metadata. Every answer carries the official source and identifier, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to these official Brazilian public APIs; nothing goes to MateMatic.
